tasks.title: P1 Architect: normalize and complete security and robustness specification signals
tasks.body: Separate specification work. Review normalized threat-model, PII registry, RBAC invariant and robustness/error-semantics predicates against all canonical document roots and actual domain contracts. Distinguish differently named existing prose from genuinely missing requirements. Record consequential security/domain decisions in the approved governance workflow; never invent legal rules or alter thresholds to get PASS.

tasks.title: P1 Architect: resolve static RBAC inventory mappings and PII classifications
tasks.body: Separate architecture/security assessment and any subsequent product fixes. Resolve statically unbound endpoint authorization against actual guards/policies and classify name-based PII candidates. An unresolved static role is not proof an endpoint is unprotected; an unlabeled name-based candidate is not proof of a legal violation. Preserve tenant/RLS request roles and SENATRAN adapter boundaries.

tasks.body: Separate product test work. Increase whole-source local unit coverage from the evidence-backed baseline, prioritize sparse packages from coverage-by-package.json and test_coherence, and disposition existing TODOs through the product workflow. Retain all existing assertions, timeouts, native 80/50 coverage thresholds and original package coverage gates. Do not claim integration/E2E or RC coverage from the local-unit report. Respect the separate unapproved P4 planning boundary.

tasks.title: P2 Architect: complete canonical source and use-case inventory traces
tasks.body: Separate specification/traceability work. Reconcile low reverse source claims, unclaimed inventory entries and absent use-case refs.routeIds/refs.endpointIds. Use the complete inventory populations, classify generated-source ownership explicitly, and retain source alignment and max_orphans thresholds. Producer REVIEW is a supported finding, not a missing input.

tasks.title: P2 Inspector: resolve integration and E2E mock ownership findings
tasks.body: Separate test-design work. Review each installed idiomaticity finding for integration/E2E mock ownership, distinguish deliberate external-port substitutions from hidden subject replacement, and improve evidence where needed. Do not delete assertions or weaken timeouts, gates or fixture isolation.

tasks.title: P2 Architect: remediate classified harness and historical governance findings
tasks.body: Separate governance/harness work from measurement enablement. Address seven gate invariants lacking measurable_via entries, evaluate workflow action-version drift and concurrency policy, and assess composite/reusable workflow advisories on merit. Reconcile the strict docs-drift entrypoint predicate with the valid pinned constitution and registered doctor. Supplemental schema ADR citations, legacy ADR frontmatter, historical missing round/closure records and archive-mutation diagnostics need forward compatibility/migration decisions, without rewriting evidence or sealed history. Native FAIL/REVIEW remains unchanged during triage.

tasks.title: P3 Engineer: investigate canonical inventory generation duration
tasks.body: Separate tooling performance work. Investigate the installed store-reader p95 across its explicitly archived historical duration population, distinguish current execution from pooled historical observations, and profile expensive inventory kinds. Retain installed 2000/5000 ms thresholds; do not purge historical readings to improve the result.
